summary: Trinity exits a broken window onto a fire escape and looks down to see Agent Smith waiting in the alley below, forcing her to continue upward. On the roof, she is pursued by Agent Brown and a unit of police. Trinity jumps between rooftops with fluid precision, contrasting with the wild jumps of the cops, though Agent Brown matches her unnatural grace. As they reach a wide back alley, a cop declares they have her. Trinity launches across a gap of over 40 feet, landing and somersaulting up to continue running. A cop exclaims it is impossible as Agent Brown replicates the move exactly, landing and rolling up to one knee.

what_changes.after: Forced to navigate open rooftop terrain with no downward escape

event_hint.one_line: Trinity is forced to jump across rooftops to escape Agents and police.
